prompt: Why do human red blood cells live only about 120 days?

options.text: They have no nucleus, so they cannot repair themselves
The heart destroys them with every beat
They turn into white blood cells

explanation: Without a nucleus, the cell gains room for hemoglobin but cannot make new proteins to fix damage, so its life is short.

prompt: Which organs remove most old red blood cells?
explanation: Immune cells in the spleen and liver clear out old red cells, and their iron is recycled to build new ones.
